text:
marta_finance: Heads up — customer AcmeAI opened a dispute: their contract credits didn't reduce the Dedicated commit invoice for Feb. They say 100k credit should have applied but invoice still shows full Dedicated usage. Invoice INV-2026-243. Can billing + infra take a look?

priya_billing: Looking now. Running a quick ledger query. My initial hunch: credits were consumed on the hosted billing account but Dedicated usage was billed under a different sub-account.

priya_billing: Query I ran:
```
SELECT invoice_id, billing_account, line_type, amount, credit_code
FROM ledger.transactions
WHERE customer_id='acmeai' AND invoice_date BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-28'
ORDER BY timestamp;
```

priya_billing: Results show contract_credit rows with billing_account = 'hosted-main' and Dedicated usage rows billed to 'dedicated-pool-001'. So credits never landed on the Dedicated lines.

jay_infra: We rolled a tagging change when migrating some Dedicated pools late Jan. Possible emitter bug — some clusters may still emit the old billing_account tag. I'll run a tag audit across the Feb window.

sam_am: FYI customer escalated via CS. They expect the 100k to cover Feb Dedicated usage per contract. ETA?

marta_finance: If it's a tag mismatch we need a retroactive credit memo / journal entry and an ops fix. Priya, what's the manual remediation flow and how long does finance take to approve?

priya_billing: Manual flow: create a credit memo (negative invoice) for the affected Dedicated invoice lines, then apply the contract credit to offset that memo. I'll need the raw transaction ids and amounts. If total < $25k we can use expedited approvals, otherwise typical review.

jay_infra: Quick find: three pools with incorrect tags during the window: pool-ded-03, pool-ded-07, pool-ded-11. They reported to 'hosted-default' between 2026-02-03 and 2026-02-18. Example from metering log:
```
# grep output snippet
2026-02-04T03:12:11Z meter: cluster=pool-ded-03 billing_account=hosted-default tokens=1.2e6
```
I'll gather full list + timestamps and push a patch to the emitter to restore correct tag.

priya_billing: Good — send me the list + timestamp ranges. I'll prepare the ledger export and draft journal entries. Creating the memo should be quick once I have raw tx ids. I'll also open a manual support ticket for tracking.

billing-bot: Automated: Created support ticket #BILL-9876 for manual credit memo and linked ledger export placeholder.

liam_finance: Looping in. I can approve journals <= $25k via expedited path. If the delta exceeds that, we'll need stack-level sign-off. Please attach the ledger export and a short justification note.

sam_am: Customer will accept a credit memo as resolution but wants confirmation before EOD Friday. Can we meet that? I'll be the point of contact and will cc the customer on the confirmation email.

marta_finance: Action items:
- jay_infra: full list of affected clusters + times (blocker for ledger mapping)
- priya_billing: generate ledger export + draft credit memo, attach tx ids
- liam_finance: review/approve if under threshold
- sam_am: draft customer email once memo created
Target: EOD Friday. :white_check_mark:

jay_infra: PR created to fix emitter: github.com/redwood/emitters/pull/1234. I'll also add a nightly audit job to detect Dedicated usage billed outside 'dedicated-pool-*' and alert #eng-sre.

priya_billing: Uploaded ledger export to internal share (link: internal-only). Drafting credit memo now. Will paste amounts in this thread once ready.

marta_finance: Thanks all. Once priya posts numbers, Liam — can you confirm expedited approval path? I'll draft the short justification.

liam_finance: Confirmed — if total retroactive memo <= $25k I'll sign off today. If larger, we'll route for leadership review.

sam_am: Customer updated: they appreciate the quick triage. I'll wait for the memo and will send confirmation.

marta_finance: Closing the loop: please post final memo id and ticket here when done so I can mark the dispute resolved in the CRM.

priya_billing: Will post. Ticket #BILL-9876 now has draft memo ID DRAFT-CM-451.

billing-bot: Automated note: ticket #BILL-9876 status = in_progress.

marta_finance: Great — thanks everyone.
